title: Categorical Radford isomorphism for the fourth dual
difficulty_reason: The existing inputs give the dual canonical bimodule (7.59), the tensor comparison ρ of the two free Hopf-bimodule realizations and their full faithfulness. The new author proof obtains the A** algebra conjugation (7.65), transports the double-dual ρ** to right A-modules, explicitly composes it with the invertible-object insertions and the other ρ comparison to get δ̃, and descends δ̃ through (7.18.5a) to a natural tensor isomorphism in C. This full transfer and descent of coherent functor data are not supplied by ordinary Hopf reconstruction, the objectwise dual formulas in 6.4.3, or the returned 7.18.7 object identification.

source_roles.source_scope: For a finite tensor category C, canonical algebra A in C⊠C^op and dual distinguished invertible D defined by (7.59), the original natural tensor isomorphism is δ_V:V^{**}→D⊗{}^{**}V⊗D^{-1}. Preserve both different double duals and tensoriality, with no pivotal, braided, semisimple or Hopf-algebra-only restriction. The identification D≅X_ρ* from 7.18.7 is needed by the later fusion corollary, not by the displayed construction itself.
source_roles.source_label_caveats: The original ρ̃_V display in physical194 ends the source with a bare ⊗ before the isomorphism sign. Its complete source object with A is printed in the following δ̃ composition. In that composition the last arrow is labelled id⊗ρ without an inverse mark, while the printed source and target use the opposite direction from (7.55). Both endpoints and the supplied natural tensor isomorphism are explicit. Preserve the original image and these local label observations; no typeset repair or substitute author proof. The author also gives (7.65) as the compressed algebra identification from (7.59), using the ordinary dual/regular-module endomorphism setting. Keep that original proof granularity.
